time_blocks.strategy: The easiest marks. Skip any GA question that takes >3 min; come back later.
Every question you can finish in 2–3 min. Decide in 20 sec: now, later, or skip.
The "later" pile: you know the method but it takes multi-step computation.
Review marked questions, check numerical entries, avoid wild guesses on MCQs.
